stories.blurb: Since 2019 the Green Legacy Initiative has mobilised millions of citizens toward a 65-billion-tree goal before Ethiopia hosts the UN climate conference in 2027.
stories.title_key: ethiopia pace plant 56 billionth tree year

stories.headline: Scientists revived a “dead” antibiotic against superbugs
stories.blurb: Cold Spring Harbor and Scripps paired vancomycin with a new molecule, pghi-4, that disables bacteria's resistance — cutting the killing dose up to 8-fold in mice.
stories.title_key: scientists revived dead antibiotic against superbugs
